Meet Pippin

The heart behind
The Snippity Pip.

Experience, creativity and the belief that a little personal attention goes a long way.

Hairdresser. Creative. Educator.

A passion for hair.
A care for people.

Pippin has more than 20 years of hairdressing experience with Toni & Guy, working across Devon and Cornwall, with experience at Essensuals Toni & Guy in Covent Garden.

Her work spans technical services, advanced cutting and styling, bridal and occasion hair, extensions and scalp care. She is trained in Malibu C Head Lab scalp therapy and mesh integration.

At The Snippity Pip, the approach is personal: time to understand what you want, thoughtful advice and one-to-one care throughout your appointment.

Pippin x
